subject: Request: brief reference session and interview planning for Nova Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@novahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief reference session and interview planning for Nova Health

Hi Kelly —

Hope you’re doing well. We’re preparing a short customer reference piece to highlight how Nova Health is using Redwood Inference in production, and I wanted to check whether you’d be open to a short (30–40 minute) discovery interview with your team so we can capture:

- Key business outcomes and impact metrics
- Which teams/stakeholders were involved in the rollout
- Any technical or operational notes other customers might find useful

Proposed format: 30–40 minute Zoom, we’ll record for internal note-taking and produce a short case summary and a 1–2 line quote for marketing. I’ve attached a simple consent form (pdf) we use for recording and quotes. If you’re comfortable with that, can you confirm recording + quote consent?

I’m flexible next week — a few slots that work for our team:
- Tue 5/5 10:00–10:40 PT
- Tue 5/5 16:00–16:40 PT
- Wed 5/6 09:00–09:40 PT

Or you can pick a time here: https://calendar.redwood.com/booking/5t7k-nova-ref

If it helps, would you like to include Rajesh (Platform) and someone from your analytics team? Appreciate any stakeholder names so we can tailor the agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment(s): redwood_case_study_consent_v1.pdf (pdf, 24KB)
From: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@novahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief reference session and interview planning for Nova Health

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for reaching out and for the clear agenda. Happy to participate and I’ve looped in Rajesh (Platform) — he’ll be the primary technical stakeholder. I’ll also invite Priya from Analytics; she can speak to the metrics side.

Quick notes from our side: Legal needs to do a rapid review of the consent PDF; they typically sign off within 48 hours but prefer we don’t publish anything prior to written approval. That’s fine — we’re comfortable with the recording for internal note-taking and to help you draft the summary. We’re also open to a short marketing quote, but that will need an approval step from our comms team.

For timing, Tue 5/5 16:00 PT works best for Rajesh and me. Please send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Kelly
Kelly Barnes
Head of Product Operations | Nova Health
kelly.barnes@novahealth.com

Thanks Kelly — great, Tue 5/5 16:00 PT is locked for us. I just created a calendar invite (link below) and attached a short agenda and consent form in case legal wants to reference it.

Agenda (30–40 min):
1) Intros and objectives (5 min)
2) Business outcomes and metrics (10 min)
3) Technical implementation highlights + lessons learned (10 min)
4) Short wrap: preferred quote and approvals process (5 min)

Recording: we will record for internal note-taking and to ensure accuracy for any direct quotes. We will not publish any quote without your explicit written approval. Please review the attached consent PDF and let us know any edits.

Invite (Zoom + calendar): https://calendar.redwood.com/booking/5t7k-nova-ref
Drive folder with draft agenda & questions: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nova-case-brief

If Priya can join, great — otherwise Rajesh is perfect for the technical portion. Thanks again — look forward to it.

— Karthik
Attachment(s): redwood_case_study_consent_v1.pdf (pdf, 24KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@novahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief reference session and interview planning for Nova Health

Hi all —

Quick note from the content/marketing side. During the interview we’ll aim to capture:

- One 1–2 sentence customer quote about impact (we’ll propose wording)
- A single highlight metric (e.g., latency improvement / cost savings) if you’re able to share
- One short technical callout for a sidebar (optional)

If it helps, here are three starter questions we’ll use (we won’t surprise anyone):
1) What problem were you trying to solve when you chose Redwood?
2) How has adoption changed daily workflows or product behavior?
3) Any operational tips others should know when rolling out?

We’ll keep the session tight and can follow up with the approved quote and a draft case summary for sign-off.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
From: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief reference session and interview planning for Nova Health

Thanks — Tue 5/5 16:00 PT on my calendar. Legal had a quick look and is fine with the consent form as long as we keep the final quote for written approval. PR asked that we not share any customer-identifying revenue numbers without sign-off, but high-level percentages or relative improvements are OK.

We’re good to be recorded for note-taking. Rajesh and Priya will join; I’ll also bring along our comms contact (Alma) as FYI. Please send the Zoom link and we’ll see you Tuesday.

Best,
Kelly
